The stay is an own-terms fixed period: the order is dated June 30, 1934 and stays Section 24 of Article VII for "a period of twenty days", so the stay expired on July 20, 1934, twenty days after the order's date, and at the expiration of such period the section "shall become effective". The recorded date is July 20, 1934; if the day of the order is counted as the first day, the last day of the stay is July 19, 1934, and the section becomes effective the next day. The stay reserves the President's power to order otherwise, and no held order exercises it, so the stay ended before June 14, 1935 and the repeal of June 14, 1935 (S.J. Res. 113 section 2) is a later event as to this clause.
